stories.title: İstanbul'da trafik yoğunluğu: Ana arterlerde araçlar güçlükle ilerliyor

en.title: Traffic congestion in Istanbul: Vehicles moving with difficulty on main arteries
en.summary: Evening rainfall in Istanbul contributed to heavy traffic congestion on main arteries, with vehicles experiencing significant delays.

stories.title: Savcının hesabında 640 milyonluk para trafiği: HSK, görevden uzaklaştırdı

en.title: Prosecutor's account shows 640 million in money transfers: HSK suspended from duty
en.summary: A prosecutor working in Mardin and his spouse had large sums of money flagged in their accounts by financial authorities, leading to a three-month suspension by the judicial council.

stories.title: İstanbul'da akşam saatlerinde trafik yoğunluğu yüzde 81'e çıktı

en.title: Evening traffic congestion in Istanbul reached 81 percent
en.summary: Evening rainfall in Istanbul caused traffic congestion to rise to 81 percent overall, with 83 percent on the European side and 78 percent on the Asian side.

stories.title: Son dakika...İzmir Bayraklı Belediye Başkanı CHP'den istifa etti

en.title: Breaking news: Izmir Bayrakli Mayor resigns from CHP
en.summary: The mayor of Bayrakli district in Izmir resigned from the opposition CHP party.

stories.title: Bayraklı Belediye Başkanı Önal, CHP'den istifa etti: YENİ Parti'ye mi geçecek?

en.title: Bayraklı Mayor Önal Resigns from CHP: Will He Join YENİ Party?
en.summary: The mayor of Bayraklı in İzmir resigned from the CHP political party. He is expected to join the YENİ Party.

stories.title: İletişim Başkanı Duran'dan Yeni Parti'nin skandal hareketine sert tepki: Millî iradeye ciddi bir saygısızlık

en.title: Communications Director Duran Strongly Reacts to YENİ Party's Scandal Move: Serious Disrespect to National Will
en.summary: The Presidential Communications Director criticized the YENİ Party for disrupting President Erdoğan's address at the Turkish Parliament's opening session.

stories.title: Okulda yük asansörü faciası: Kafası sıkışan 15 yaşındaki öğrenci hayatını kaybetti

en.title: School Freight Elevator Tragedy: 15-Year-Old Student Dies After Head Gets Trapped
en.summary: A ninth-grade student in Bingöl died in a hospital after his head became trapped in a school kitchen freight elevator. The incident occurred in Solhan district.

stories.title: Asansör kazasında yaralanan öğrenci hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Student Injured in Elevator Accident Dies
en.summary: A 15-year-old student named Abdülkerim Demir died following injuries sustained in an elevator accident at a high school dormitory in Solhan, Bingöl.

stories.title: Alanya Belediye Başkanı Özçelik CHP'den istifa etti

en.title: Alanya Mayor Özçelik Resigns from CHP
en.summary: Alanya Mayor Osman Tarık Özçelik resigned from the CHP after being referred to the High Discipline Board for expulsion proceedings on September 30, stating the process would not benefit the party, the city, or himself.

stories.title: Belediye başkanı CHP'den istifa etmişti! Konyaaltı meclisinde arbede çıktı

en.title: Konyaaltı Council Becomes Chaotic After Mayor's CHP Resignation
en.summary: Konyaaltı Mayor Cem Kotan, who was referred for expulsion by the CHP Central Management Board, resigned from the party, leading to a disturbance in the municipal council.

stories.title: Sosyalist Enternasyonal YENİ Parti'yi kabul etti, CHP'yi 'dondurdu'

en.title: Socialist International Accepts YENİ Party, 'Freezes' CHP Membership
en.summary: The Socialist International, an umbrella organization of social democratic and left-wing parties worldwide, suspended the CHP's membership while accepting the YENİ Party.

stories.title: Konyaaltı Belediye Başkanı Kotan, CHP'den istifa etti

en.title: Konyaaltı Mayor Kotan Resigns from CHP
en.summary: Konyaaltı Mayor Cem Kotan announced his resignation from the CHP after the party's Central Management Board referred him for expulsion through disciplinary proceedings.

stories.title: Türkiye-Ukrayna Serbest Ticaret Anlaşması yürürlüğe girdi

en.title: Turkey-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement enters into force
en.summary: Turkey and Ukraine's free trade agreement took effect on October 1, with customs duty regulations on goods trade scheduled to begin on January 1, 2027.

stories.title: Bakan Şimşek'ten fon piyasalarına ilişkin açıklama: Tasfiye ve çözümlenme süreci başladı

en.title: Finance Minister Şimşek provides statement on fund markets: Liquidation and settlement process has begun
en.summary: Turkey's Finance Minister announced that funds managed by problematic portfolio management companies have been quarantined and a liquidation process has started, preventing financial system-wide contagion.

en.title: Istanbul Stock Exchange closes day with gains
en.summary: The BIST 100 index on Istanbul Stock Exchange gained 2.53 percent to close at 12,249.04 points.

en.title: Four defendants released in İmamoğlu case
en.summary: A court ordered the release of four defendants in a case involving 436 defendants accused of organized crime related to İmamoğlu, during the trial's 91st hearing.

en.title: Fenerbahçe's transfer ban lifted
en.summary: Fenerbahçe announced that its temporary transfer ban has been removed after completing a required payment on September 27 and finishing all necessary procedures with FIFA.
